title: Discharge Readiness Score Contract (DC-DISCHARGE-SCORE-v1)
description: Discharge-readiness score contract (Sprint 09 v2 draft per design spec §3.3 / FR-DC-001, FR-DC-006). Contract only; ingestion in a later sprint. Follows the dc-demand-encounter-v1 envelope pattern. Extends the reference ontology hcp:DischargeReadinessScore ICE (bound to Encounter timeline; producedBy=ModelRunId; explanationTokens[]) — see docs/ontology/reference-layer.ttl and docs/ontology/crosswalk.md v0.2.0. ADR-0013 westus2 demo-scope exception applies at the ingestion layer for synthetic data only; PROD PHI paths remain gated on Swiss residency per ADR-0003/0004. ADR-0016 gate 1: _pseudonymisation_flag=true is explicit at the dataset envelope for demo-scope contracts.

_pseudonymisation_flag.description: ADR-0016 gate 1: demo-scope dc-*.schema.json contracts must explicitly declare that all record identifiers are pseudonymised (no PHI). Enforced by policy_gate.py in the demo-scope profile.

scoreId.description: Unique discharge-score identifier. Maps to hcp:DischargeReadinessScore in the reference ontology.

encounterId.description: Link back to DC-DEMAND-ENCOUNTER-v1 (appliesTo=Encounter per crosswalk v0.2.0).

hospitalId.description: Hospital identifier from dim_hospital (H_USZ / H_LUKS / H_SZB).

score.description: Discharge-readiness score in [0..1] from the discharge-scoring pipeline.

producedBy.description: Model run identifier (producedBy=ModelRunId per design spec §3.3).

explanationTokens.description: Model explanation tokens for the score (design spec §3.3).

weight.description: Signed contribution weight; positive raises score, negative lowers it.
